d:
Paisa vasul ke is vidiyo men samjhie myuchual phands men nivesh ka guna-bhag aur 10 hazar rupye ki SIP se karorapti banne ka pura ganit.
Har mahine sirf 10 hazar rupye ki SIP aur aap ban sakte hain karorapti? janie is dave men kitna sach hai, kitna chhalava.
Kitne sal tak nivesh karna hoga? kitna paisa aapko apni jeb se lagana parega? aur kya myuchual phand se milne vala ritarn vakaee aapko karorapti bana sakta hai? ya phir karorapti banne ka yah sapna dikhane men kuchh baten chhipa li jati hain?
